stages.name: Huts
stages.description: A ring of mud-and-wattle huts in a clearing, smoke curling from every roof hole. Everyone knows everyone, and everyone's business.
stages.gives: Meets the basic need. The settlement is a village.

stages.name: Tenements
stages.description: Crooked timber blocks lean over dirty streets. There's a roof for every newcomer, if not much else.
stages.gives: The settlement becomes a town. +1 Community skills here. While it's the top stage, crime cards are more likely here and crime checks here take −1 (dirty streets).

stages.name: Neighborhoods
stages.description: Orderly lanes of whitewashed houses, each with a garden and a neighbour who keeps an eye out.
stages.gives: The settlement becomes a city. +2 Community skills here.

stages.name: Boroughs
stages.description: Sprawling districts, each with its own market square, temple bells and fierce local pride.
stages.gives: The settlement becomes a metropolis. +3 Community skills here.

stages.name: Campfire
stages.description: A great fire pit where the stew pot never empties and hunters trade the day's catch.
stages.gives: Meets the basic need.

stages.name: Public House
stages.description: A smoky, sticky-floored room with one cook, one barrel and one opinion: take it or leave it.
stages.gives: Food need −1 here. +1 Exploration here (rumours of the wilds).

stages.name: Tavern
stages.description: Warm, loud and honest. A proper kitchen, rooms upstairs, and a board of notices for anyone hiring blades.
stages.gives: Food need −2 here. +2 Exploration, Agriculture here.

stages.name: Inn
stages.description: Polished oak, roast pheasant, feather beds. Travellers plan their routes to sleep here, and spend freely.
stages.gives: Food need −3 here. +3 Exploration, Agriculture here. +1 BP a week.

pinnacle.name: Granary Hall
pinnacle.description: Stone silos and a cooks' guild; no winter will starve this realm.
pinnacle.gives: No Food Shortage or Crop Failure can hit the kingdom while it stands. Food need −2 in every settlement.

stages.name: Shrine
stages.description: A carved post and a bowl of offerings at the clearing's edge. People touch it for luck on the way past.
stages.gives: Meets the basic need.

stages.name: Church
stages.description: A small timber church with a bell, a priest who knows every name, and a roof that leaks on holy days.
stages.gives: +1 Folklore here. −1 Unrest when built.

stages.name: Temple
stages.description: A stone temple with healers in the side halls and pilgrims at the steps.
stages.gives: +2 Folklore, Arts here. +2 vs Plague here.

stages.name: Cathedral
stages.description: Spires that catch the dawn, windows of coloured glass, choirs heard across the river.
stages.gives: +3 Folklore, Arts here. −1 Corruption a month. Fame +1 when built.

pinnacle.name: Monastery
pinnacle.description: Quiet cloisters, terraced fields and monks who brew the best ale in the realm.
pinnacle.gives: −1 Unrest each month, kingdom-wide. Pilgrims: Fame +1 each year.

stages.name: Fireside Tales
stages.description: When the work's done, someone always has a story, a fiddle, or a song about the old days.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Festival Green
stages.description: A common with a maypole, a stage of hay bales and a fair every season.
stages.gives: +1 Arts here. −1 Unrest when a festival matter succeeds here.

stages.name: Theater
stages.description: Painted scenery, a paid company and plays the nobles pretend not to enjoy.
stages.gives: +2 Arts, Folklore here.

stages.name: Opera House
stages.description: Gilded boxes and a stage the size of a field; singers come from Restov to be heard here.
stages.gives: +3 Arts, Folklore here. Fame +1 when built.

pinnacle.name: Arena
pinnacle.description: Roaring crowds, sand and steel; champions become heroes overnight.
pinnacle.gives: Once a month the ruler can call the Games: −1d4 Unrest. Some Games bring a champion's challenge the party can take on themselves.

stages.name: Trading Post
stages.description: A stockade, a counter and a trader who'll swap anything for anything, at a price.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Market
stages.description: Stalls in the square on market day: cheese, cloth, gossip and the odd stolen goat.
stages.gives: +1 Trade here. +0.5 BP a week.

stages.name: Bazaar
stages.description: Covered lanes of shops that never close, spices from distant ports, haggling in five tongues.
stages.gives: +2 Trade, Boating here. +1 BP a week.

stages.name: Pavilion
stages.description: A grand glass-roofed exchange where fortunes change hands over a glass of wine.
stages.gives: +3 Trade, Boating here. +2 BP a week.

pinnacle.name: Counting House
pinnacle.description: Ledgers, vaults and bankers who lend to princes.
pinnacle.gives: +2 BP a week, and the treasury borrows at half the interest.

stages.name: Woodpile
stages.description: Stacked logs, a charcoal pit and an axe everyone shares.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Worksite
stages.description: Sawpits, a lime kiln and a crew who'll build you anything if you feed them.
stages.gives: +1 Industry here. +0.5 BP a week per work site in its hex area.

stages.name: Workshops
stages.description: A street of craftsmen: cobblers, coopers, weavers, each with an apprentice and a grudge.
stages.gives: +2 Industry, Trade here. Cuts project costs here by 10%.

stages.name: Smithies
stages.description: Hammers ring dawn to dusk; the furnaces glow all night.
stages.gives: +3 Industry, Trade here. Cuts project costs here by 20%.

pinnacle.name: Foundry
pinnacle.description: Great bellows and molten rivers of iron; the realm's arms and tools come from here.
pinnacle.gives: Every project in the kingdom costs 10% less; armies are outfitted for less.

stages.name: Meeting Stump
stages.description: An old oak stump where folk stand to speak and the elders listen.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Longhouse
stages.description: A long timber hall with a fire down the middle, where disputes are settled over mead.
stages.gives: +1 Politics, Statecraft here. +1 vs audiences here.

stages.name: Town Hall
stages.description: A stone hall with a clock tower, clerks, records and a mayor's chain of office.
stages.gives: +2 Politics, Statecraft here. −1 Corruption when built.

stages.name: Palace
stages.description: Marble halls, a throne room and the court of the realm. Envoys wait days to be seen.
stages.gives: +3 Politics, Statecraft here. Capital only. Each royal power can be used twice a month.

pinnacle.name: Embassy Row
pinnacle.description: Flags of a dozen nations, guarded gates and dinners where treaties are written on napkins.
pinnacle.gives: +2 vs Emissary matters and audiences anywhere in the kingdom, and every audience offers one extra answer.

stages.name: Lantern Post
stages.description: A lantern on a pole and a volunteer with a cudgel and a loud voice.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Watch House
stages.description: A small barracks for the night watch, with a cell that's usually full of drunks.
stages.gives: +1 Intrigue here. +1 vs crime events here.

stages.name: Constabulary
stages.description: Uniformed constables, a jail and a sergeant who knows every fence in town.
stages.gives: +2 Intrigue here. +2 vs crime events. Crime −1 when built.

stages.name: Magistrate's Court
stages.description: Robed judges, a courtroom gallery and justice that is seen to be done.
stages.gives: +3 Intrigue, Politics here. −1 Crime a month.

pinnacle.name: Shadow Network
pinnacle.description: Informants in every tavern; nothing happens here the crown doesn't hear of.
pinnacle.gives: You see the next event card before it lands, and can have the Emissary try to head it off.

stages.name: Palisade
stages.description: Sharpened logs and a ditch; enough to stop wolves and keep out the curious.
stages.gives: +1 vs Bandits and Monsters here.

stages.name: Earthworks
stages.description: Banked ramparts with a timber gatehouse and a watchtower over the road.
stages.gives: +1 Defense here. +1 vs all dangerous events here.

stages.name: Stone Walls
stages.description: Grey walls, towers on every corner and gates that close at sunset.
stages.gives: +2 Defense here. +2 vs dangerous events here.

stages.name: Citadel
stages.description: Walls within walls, a keep on the hill and granaries for a year-long siege.
stages.gives: +3 Defense, Warfare here. +3 vs dangerous events. −1 Strife a month.

pinnacle.name: Watchtowers
pinnacle.description: A ring of beacons across the hills; no raider arrives unannounced.
pinnacle.gives: +1 vs dangerous events in every hex next to any of your settlements.

stages.name: Muster Field
stages.description: A trampled field where farmers drill with spears on feast days.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Barracks
stages.description: Bunks, a mess hall and a sergeant who wakes everyone before dawn.
stages.gives: +1 Warfare here. +1 vs Bandits and Monsters here.

stages.name: Garrison
stages.description: A walled compound of professional soldiers, stables and an armoury.
stages.gives: +2 Warfare, Defense here. +2 vs Bandits and Monsters here.

stages.name: War College
stages.description: Officers study maps of old battles; the realm's generals are made here.
stages.gives: +3 Warfare, Defense here. +1 Military realm-stat point a week.

pinnacle.name: Knightly Order
pinnacle.description: A chapterhouse of sworn knights who ride out at the first sign of trouble.
pinnacle.gives: Fame +1 when built, and one free reroll a month on any Military card.

stages.name: Hedge-Witch's Hut
stages.description: A crooked hut of herbs and bones where the wise woman reads the signs.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Library
stages.description: Shelves of salvaged books and a librarian who guards them like a dragon.
stages.gives: +1 Scholarship, Magic here.

stages.name: Academy
stages.description: Lecture halls, students arguing in the yard, a tower for star-watching.
stages.gives: +2 Scholarship, Magic here. +1 Arcane realm-stat point a week.

stages.name: Arcane College
stages.description: Wizards' towers around a quad; the air hums and the lamps light themselves.
stages.gives: +3 Magic, Scholarship here. +1 Arcane point a week. Fame +1 when built.

pinnacle.name: University
pinnacle.description: Scholars of every field, from law to medicine; the realm's minds are trained here.
pinnacle.gives: +2 Arcane points a week, and one free reroll a month on any Arcane card.

stages.name: Well and Ditches
stages.description: A dug well and drainage ditches; the mud is almost manageable.
stages.gives: No bonus yet; opens the track.

stages.name: Paved Streets
stages.description: Cobbled roads and a bridge over the stream; carts no longer sink to the axle.
stages.gives: +1 Engineering here. Decay −1 when built.

stages.name: Aqueduct
stages.description: Arches stride over the fields carrying clean water to every fountain.
stages.gives: +2 Engineering here. +2 vs Plague and Local Disaster here.

stages.name: Sewers and Lamps
stages.description: Tunnels beneath, glowing lamps above; the city is clean and bright at night.
stages.gives: +3 Engineering, Magic here. −1 Decay a month. Food need −1.

pinnacle.name: Great Bridge
pinnacle.description: A span of stone that turns the river from a barrier into a highway.
pinnacle.gives: +1 Boating everywhere and +1 BP a week. Needs a waterside metropolis.
